global_reveal_boundary: Data administrator already announced BREADY while analysis tool was being written; not a preregistration before all-team outcome access. The prescribed year/block design preceded that announcement.
default_bootstrap_unit: calendar year, sharing every March/September market/industry row
sensitivity: fixed noncircular two consecutive calendar-year moving blocks, concatenate ceil(K/2) draws and truncate to K observed years; no gaps considered adjacent
existing_date_bootstrap: retained for descriptive comparison; no selection by intervals or signs
comparison: NIGHT_CALENDAR_CONTROL60 versus prior EQUITY_BENCHMARK60 separately; more dates do not mean more independent years
missing_outcomes: exclude unresolved/pending from score; retain all locked rows in CSV and exante-neighbor pool
calibration_figure: static matplotlib PNG/PDF market and seven sector proxies; frozen p40/50/60 vs actualup; const60/idealreference; no independent-binomial-CI
